learning.title: Keep one axe runner per Storybook preview frame
learning.trigger: A Playwright Storybook accessibility test fails with Axe is already running.
learning.mistake: Enabled Storybook's automatic addon-a11y axe test while the Playwright suite independently ran AxeBuilder against the same preview frame.
learning.rule: Choose one authoritative axe execution for a given preview frame. If Playwright owns the canonical sweep, disable the addon's automatic run and keep the explicit Playwright assertion as the CI gate.

verification.command: pnpm --dir packages/ui exec playwright test tests/storybook.spec.ts tests/visual-parity.spec.ts --project=chromium
verification.requirement: All Storybook and visual-parity cases pass without concurrent axe execution.
